rules.name: cs-07-statement-inputs-legacy-vs-new-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT 'legacy valuation_date_table' AS what, value_date, settlement_date, NULL AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy statement cache', max(value_date), NULL, count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy security_settlement_value_table_cfs latest', max(value_date), NULL, count(DISTINCT value_date) FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs

SELECT 'new valuation_date_table' AS what, value_date, settlement_date, NULL::bigint AS row_count FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'new statement cache', max(value_date), NULL, count(*) FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent, security_id, subportfolio, market_action, transaction_date, original_lots, premium, netting_status, netting_date, is_fixing_done, fixing_date, opt_periodicity, deal_status, trade_source FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs WHERE subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND transaction_date < :valueDate AND counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400'

SELECT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent, security_id, subportfolio, market_action, transaction_date, original_lots, premium, netting_status, netting_date, is_fixing_done, fixing_date, opt_periodicity, deal_status, trade_source FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND is_latest_version = 1 AND subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND transaction_date < :valueDate AND counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400'

SELECT a.trade_id, a.value_date AS lots_date, a.active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(value_date) AS value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date <= :valueDate GROUP BY trade_id) m ON m.trade_id = a.trade_id AND m.value_date = a.value_date
SELECT trade_id, value_date AS lots_date, active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT security_id, derivative_type, product_code, currency, contract_month, maturity_date, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, strike, strike1, strike2, barrier_type, barrier1_level, barrier2_level, averaging_startdate, averaging_enddate FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs

SELECT security_id, derivative_type, product_code, currency, contract_month, maturity_date, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, strike, strike1, strike2, barrier_type, barrier1_level, barrier2_level, averaging_startdate, averaging_enddate FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'
SELECT trade_id, financial_year, premium FROM dbsystemuat.premium_fy_table_cfs
SELECT trade_id, financial_year, premium FROM opera.premium_fy_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'
SELECT trade_id, is_premium_paid, netting_status FROM dbsystemuat.rms_premium_paid_table_cfs
SELECT trade_id, is_premium_paid, netting_status FROM opera.rms_premium_paid_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'
SELECT lower(underlying_id) AS price_key, underlying_id, settle_value, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT lower(underlying_id) AS price_key, underlying_id, settle_value, settlement_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, average_till_now FROM dbsystemuat.security_average_till_now_monitoring_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, average_till_now FROM opera.security_average_till_now_monitoring_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT trade_id, contract_number, fixing_date, fixing_rate FROM dbsystemuat.fixing_table_cfs
SELECT trade_id, contract_number, fixing_date, fixing_rate FROM opera.fixing_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT invenio_product_code, bbg_product_code, currency, lot_mult, constant_curr_mult, curr_mult_factor, curr_mult_type, constant_nc_factor, murex_mult, price_conv_factor FROM dbsystemuat.product_master_table

SELECT DISTINCT ON (invenio_product_code) invenio_product_code, bbg_product_code, currency, lot_mult, constant_curr_mult, curr_mult_factor, curr_mult_type, constant_nc_factor, murex_mult, price_conv_factor FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant OR tenant_id IS NULL ORDER BY invenio_product_code, CASE WHEN tenant_id = :tenant THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT currency, spot, quantotype FROM dbsystemuat.currency_spot_mapping_table
SELECT currency, spot, quantotype FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT client_code, client_name, counterparty_parent, generate_statement, client_status FROM dbsystemuat.client_master_data_cfs
SELECT client_code, client_name, counterparty_parent, generate_statement, client_status FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT DISTINCT m.currency, m.spot AS config_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spelling FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) = lower(trim(m.spot)) AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT p.curr_mult_factor AS config_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spelling, count(*) AS products, string_agg(p.invenio_product_code, ', ' ORDER BY p.invenio_product_code) AS product_codes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tenant_id IS NULL) AS shared_rows FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) = lower(trim(p.curr_mult_factor)) AND u.underlying_id <> p.curr_mult_factor WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant OR p.tenant_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT d.counterparty_parent AS deal_value, c.client_name AS client_master_value, c.client_code, count(*) AS deals FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera.client_master_data c ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = d.business_unit AND lower(trim(c.client_name)) = lower(trim(d.counterparty_parent)) AND c.client_name <> d.counterparty_parent WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT s.product_code AS security_value, p.invenio_product_code AS product_master_value, count(*) AS securities FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.product_master_table p ON lower(trim(p.invenio_product_code)) = lower(trim(s.product_code)) AND p.invenio_product_code <> s.product_code WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY 1, 2

expect.reason: spot ids must equal the price spelling exactly in PostgreSQL (legacy ignores case)
product FX spot id must equal the price spelling exactly (else FX factor 1)
deal counterparty must equal the client name exactly (else no client code)
security product code must equal product master exactly (else no multipliers)
same lots as of the value date
same prices and same spelling (CASE_ONLY = letter case)
multipliers and FX spot id spelled as legacy
